reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing getMonthActionCategories / forEachMonthActionCategory helpers, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own in-loop hidden check and gets the flag applied separately.

duplication.why: The hidden rule and its new opt-out now live in two places (the SQL filter in getMonthActionCategories and the row check in copyPreviousMonth), a pre-existing split the change extends rather than closes.

placement.why: The flag is handled in the server budget actions module where the category selection already lives, and the shared MonthActionArgs type propagates to handlers via typeof.

scope.why: Only the flag plumbing and one focused test.

maintainability.why: Clean shared argument type and a single parameter on the selection helper; the remaining copyPreviousMonth special path means a future hidden-rule change must still touch two spots.
